title: Baconit Windows Phone Marketplace capture history
notes: Version labels come from the archived store listing, not from image filenames or inferred release dates.

Wayback may serve an image captured before or after the requested listing date. capture_url records the final image replay URL when available; a null value means the exact image capture was not recorded by the original snapshot tool.
Listings sharing the same ordered screenshot URLs are grouped together. This does not prove that every screenshot depicts the exact listed app version.
Images retain their recovered bytes and native resolution. The March 2, 2012 listing also has a local HTML, PDF, and full-page screenshot archive.

captures.version_evidence: The archived listing explicitly displays 1.7.0.0 in #version.
